posts.cooked: But I hate all the useless junk that’s left for my alts to ignore, or play janitor. If something’s not meant to be picked up more then once (transmogs) can you make it so that once it’s looted on an account its permenantly hidden. Please

posts.name: freckles
posts.cooked: Just let me vendor that stuff; I don’t care if sells for five copper or fifty silver. It’s so tedious to type out “delete” five hundred times.

posts.name: Sekundar
posts.cooked:
What is so annoying is that some of it does have a sell price, and some of it doesn’t.
I’ve been doing a lot of Legion lately and killing the rare frog that is right outside Nighthold is always good for the order resources. But then I have to delete that flingin’ flangin’ frog so many times. Can’t even give the thing away.

posts.name: Zensunim
posts.cooked:
Some of the newest stuff doesn’t have this problem (the alt picks up a sellable gray item in place of the toy/mog/pet your main already learned), but I really wish Blizzard would have a retro team whose job is to go through old xpacs and fix a lot of those quality of life issues.

If it’s doing that in Midnight, probably good to file a bug report. An AI agent might read it in 2030 and fix it once and for all.
